answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake bond that unlocks only gradually as the agent completes verified work. Like a river cutting slowly through tundra, trust accumulates over time rather than arriving instantly, so a newcomer at its nadir of reputation cannot vote, escrow, or route payments at full weight. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand bonds and wait through the same slow ramp, while cheating forfeits the bond — making forgery expensive, slow, and unprofitable compared with running one honest agent.
